function.name: helpDocSearchFunc
function.description: Retrieves help documentation for Webex collaboration products from the online help site based on the user's search query. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search keyword or phrase for querying the help documents, such as 'video conference setup' or 'account management'.

language.description: The language preference for the help documentation.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of help documents to return in the search results. Defaults to 10.

function.name: getMeetingTranscriptFunc
function.description: Retrieves the transcript of a meeting including details such as topics, agendas, and discussions. If a duration is not specified, the transcript for the last 10 minutes will be fetched. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

meetingID.description: The unique identifier for the meeting whose transcript is being requested.

lastDurationInSeconds.description: The duration for which the transcript is requested, in seconds. If not specified, defaults to the last 600 seconds (10 minutes).

message.content:
I’m happy to help you figure out whether you’ve been handed any tasks during your current meeting! Because I don’t yet know which specific meeting you’re in—or what “tasks” means in your workflow—I’ll give you two quick options: | Option | What it does | How to proceed | |--------|--------------|----------------| | **1️⃣ Look directly inside the meeting** | In most Webex meetings, participants who receive action items can view them under the *Tasks* pane (or the “Action Items” section) while the meeting is live. | • While still in the meeting window, click the **… More actions** button → **Show Tasks**.
• Any pending tasks addressed to you should appear here. | | **2️⃣ Search the recent transcript** | Sometimes tasks are spoken aloud but never formally added to the Task list. By pulling the latest transcript we can spot phrases like “action item,” “task,” or “you need to…” that refer to responsibilities. | • Tell me the meeting’s `meetingID`, then I can pull the last 10‑minute transcript for you. | If you’d prefer option 2, just share the `meetingID`. Otherwise, try opening the Tasks panel yourself—most users can see all assignments right away without needing extra steps. Let me know which route works best for you!
